I can’t reliably evaluate this many assignments by hand, so I don’t want to invent final values. You can get the exact result by pasting the assignment block into `source` here:

```python
env = {}

for raw in source.splitlines():
    line = raw.split("//", 1)[0].strip().rstrip(";").strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    lhs, rhs = map(str.strip, line.split("<-", 1))
    env[lhs] = int(rhs) if rhs.isdigit() else env[rhs]

print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {env[name]}" for name in ("a", "b", "c", "d", "TMP")))
```
